ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels occupying approximately 90% of the visible surface area, with sparse high-intensity (white) pixel clusters forming high-contrast focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary pigment is a uniform dark charcoal. High-contrast white blobs are scattered across both lobes, with a notable concentration of linear white pixel clusters in the medial region of the right lobe and circular spots near the lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 55-degree internal angle; notch depth extends significantly toward the fluke's insertion point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed along the entire horizontal boundary. Distinct jagged indentations are visible on the distal margin of the left lobe, creating an irregular pixel-level silhouette.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upper margins tapering to acute, slightly rounded distal tips; trailing edge follows a broadly symmetrical path from the medial notch to the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters (2-5 pixels in diameter) consistent with barnacle attachment scars, localized primarily along the trailing edges and near the left lateral tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinctive diagonal, light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the right lobe, oriented toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scratching (rake marks) on the right lobe and visible irregularity/loss of tissue at the distal tip of the left lobe.
